answer: Beacon-decay bond: each identity plants a beacon in karst, locks 70 bond, files a key-bound serial. Each epoch it must send a fresh sable pulse proving new work. Silence slides it down the public velvet curve; below the floor the bond burns. An auditor replays the curve, burning copies; rented pulses fail. First pulse 35, k-th 35+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,031,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 35 once and get it back.
